items.title: 68190_Samuel
items.q: he said my name is Jesse Aiken, what might be your name. I said Baby Lovett, so what.

ctx.x: What happened, man, is those little cats I was playing at the Star Theatre, Shreveport, Louisiana. The Whitman Sisters was there, you remember them, all pretty girls. And I was -- Alice was my girl friend and I thought I was a pimp, she bought me with silk shirts and all that kind of stuff, man. So I'm living right back of the theatre, I can walk out of the theatre into my house, you know, about (inaudible) back there. And oh, they were there man, I was trying to show off, man. You know, they

had xylophones and all that stuff, playin' em piano man and a little guy just stood there and watched me I guess about a half hour just standing looking at me, just play like that. I said, man what is the guy watching me for, you understand what I mean? So we had intermission see, and he asked me, he said, would you mind -- he said my name is Jesse Aiken, what might be your name. I said Baby Lovett, so what. I was supposed to be great, you know.

Then we played, had another intermission, he's still standing there looking at me, and then he asked me, this is the way he approached me. 'Would you mind if I beat a piece fine drums s***n' up there, xylophones and all that stuff, on your drum?' I said, sure, man, (inaudible) That cat played so much drum, man, I walked out the back. I walked out the back, I told my wife I was sick. And she said you'd better go in there and take your medicine, or something like that. I said, I've got a headache, you know. The…
